action.command:
cd /workspace && docker exec yii2_vue_dash_container bash -c '
# get login page, extract CSRF token and form fields
RESP=$(curl -s -c /tmp/cj.txt http://127.0.0.1/administration/login)
echo "$RESP" | grep -oE "<input[^>]*(name=\"[^\"]*\")[^>]*>" | head -10
TOKEN=$(echo "$RESP" | grep -oE "name=\"_csrf\" value=\"[^\"]+\"" | sed -E "s/.*value=\"([^\"]+)\".*/\1/")
echo "CSRF=$TOKEN"
curl -s -b /tmp/cj.txt -c /tmp/cj.txt -o /dev/null -w "login_post_code=%{http_code} redirect=%{redirect_url}\n" -X POST http://127.0.0.1/administration/login -d "_csrf=$TOKEN" -d "LoginForm[username]=admin" -d "LoginForm[password]=QUJhwuG8KQtCPFyv"
'
